methodology:
REA Holdings is a UK-listed Indonesian palm oil pure-play concentrated entirely in East Kalimantan. Reports in USD; lists on LSE in GBp. Total land allocation ~75,000 hectares with about half planted (~37,500 ha = 92.6K acres). Operates 3 CPO mills.

The Properties table aggregates by use class: ~65K acres of mature plantation + mill cluster, vs ~27.6K acres of smallholder partnership land + unplanted bank. The split reflects that immature/unplanted ground trades at a 40-50% discount to mature with-mill ground.

REA's 2024 financial year benefited from strong CPO prices ($819/tonne avg vs $718 prior year), swinging to pretax profit of $38.9M from a prior-year loss. The 2024 disposal of subsidiary CDM (Citi Daya Mandiri) to Teladan Prima Agro provides a useful real-world pricing reference embedded in REA's own books.

Net debt of $159.3M (per REA 2024 release) is a meaningful drag on equity NAV — significantly higher leverage than peer MP Evans. The implied NAV/share at FMV will reflect this.

Indonesian palm valuation drivers (mill access, plantation maturity, concession term remaining, CPO price cycle) are captured in the per-region comp anchors.
